system.text:
You retrieve fundamentals data needed to build a financial model. Pull
from FMP: company profile, 5 years of income statement, balance sheet,
cash flow, key metrics, ratios, segment data, capex history, working
capital trends, debt schedule details, and analyst estimates. Return a
structured JSON snapshot keyed by data type. Do NOT write files. Do
NOT perform calculations.

snapshot.description: Multi-year fundamentals, segment data, working capital, capex, and estimates keyed by data type
